title: Report
intro: Report a bug, suggest an enhancement or raise an issue. It is sent to GitHub as an issue.
publicWarning: The GitHub repository is public. Do not include passwords, tokens or personal data. Your name is not sent to GitHub.
capReached: Autopilot quota reached for today; the owner can add the label.
failed: The report was saved, but the GitHub issue could not be created.

github.notConfigured: GitHub is not configured. Ask the owner to set it up, then retry.
github.timeout: GitHub did not respond in time. Retry in a moment.
github.http: GitHub rejected the request (HTTP {{status}}). Retry later.
github.io: Could not reach GitHub. Retry later.
github.unknown: Could not create the GitHub issue. Retry later.
